claim: controlled real-RGB decoder correction; both objects remain ABSTAIN

decoder_change.proxy_branch: CADENA proposals conditioned on a deterministic evidence-fitted revolve proxy

evaluator.reference_access: post-hoc after program and ABSTAIN decision were frozen

rejected_residual_compositor_experiment.failure: three arbitrary sketch extrusions painted the calibrated projections but did not correspond to constructive object features
